Bug_Title: "@SpringBootApplication" and "@ComponentScan" should not be used in the default package
Bug_Explanation: @SpringBootApplication and @ComponentScan are used in the default package, which can cause the entire classpath to be scanned, leading to a slow start-up or failure due to scanning unintended packages.
